record.field: SELECT b.ebelp,c.arrdate,c.mblnr,c.ebeln,c.vbeln_vl,a.BSART,b.PSTYP,b.MATNR,b.menge,b.meins,b.WERKS,a.RESWK,marm.umrez,marm.umren FROM zmm_ts_sto c LEFT JOIN EKKO a ON a.EBELN = c.EBELN LEFT JOIN EKPO b ON a.EBELN = b.EBELN LEFT JOIN MARM marm ON marm.matnr = b.matnr AND marm.meinh = b.meins WHERE b.pstyp = '7' AND c.mblnr != ' ' AND c.vbeln_vl != ' ' AND TO_DATE(c.arrdate,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE-30 AND CURRENT_DATE
